mentions.name: Sing On Key
mentions.description: A singing training app where users sing a pitch line and get a score. It lets users sing along to any original song by listening along rather than playing the song itself, and is being expanded with Linux and Windows versions plus internationalization of the app and landing page using Fable 5.1.
mentions.problem: Bad singers need a way to practice singing in tune and on pitch.
mentions.audience: Bad singers who want to improve their singing
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://singonkey.app

A singing training app for bad singers. You sing the pitch line and get a score. Let's you sing to any original song by listening along and not playing the song itself.
